He was intoxicated by the taste of the butter and thus, the name Madhana Mohana or Madhava was given to him. This incident is believed to have occurred during Lord Krishna's childhood.

Another reference to the name Madhan is found in the Harivansh Purana. In this epic, King Madhava is described as the ruler of the Vrishni kingdom.
